summary: Ninja Theory's post-apocalyptic Journey to the West adaptation, later released on PC as a Premium Edition with DLC.

entries.title: Enslaved: Odyssey to the West

emulation.notes: Use the PC Premium Edition natively.

primary.why: Enslaved released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2010, then Windows in 2013 as a Premium Edition bundling the base game with Pigsy's Perfect 10 DLC and skins. Windows Premium Edition is both the highest-fidelity and most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Premium Edition natively; it includes the Pigsy's Perfect 10 DLC package.

all_releases.fidelity: Premium Edition PC release bundling the base game, Pigsy's Perfect 10 DLC, and skins.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete sourced edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release; later Premium Edition was also sold through PlayStation Network.
all_releases.reason: skip: Windows Premium Edition is higher fidelity and includes the DLC package.
skip: lower practical fidelity than Windows Premium Edition and no sourced content advantage.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows Premium Edition combines fidelity and DLC completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later remaster is documented in the cited public source; the Premium Edition is the complete-route release.
